bundle.longDescription: Ksav (כְּתָב) is a Hebrew-first writing system built on the real Typst compiler. It typesets Hebrew documents with proper RTL, nikud, and a full note apparatus — footnotes, endnotes, section notes, side notes and parallel commentary streams — that word processors cannot produce.
